team_archive.title: Archive {{name}}?
team_archive.body: {{name}} leaves every list and no new run can use it. Its versions stay readable, and an admin can restore it.
team_archive.noRuns: No run that has not ended uses it.

note.one: {{names}} stays not ready on every computer until an admin removes {{name}} from it or restores it.
note.many: {{names}} stay not ready on every computer until an admin removes {{name}} from them or restores it.

team_archive.readFailed: What uses it could not be read, so it cannot be archived now.
team_archive.notReached: The team server could not be reached, so what uses it is not known and nothing can be archived now.

refused.notAdmin: Only team admins archive the team's resources: the team server refused it.
refused.runsChanged: The runs it stops changed while this list was open. The list shows them now; archive again once you have read it.
refused.conflict: {{name}} changed on the team server since this page read it. Nothing was archived; look at it again.
refused.other: The team server refused it ({{code}}). Nothing was archived.
